english.note: Use this for the insecure, reassurance-seeking side of emotional neediness rather than its outwardly clingy behaviour.
Use this when someone feels insecure or vulnerable because something normally reassuring is missing.

examples.english: They keep asking whether I still love them; they’re really needy.
examples.traditional: 佢成日問我仲愛唔愛佢，真係好冇安全感。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 man6 ngo5 zung6 oi3 m4 oi3 keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 on1 cyun4 gam2

examples.english: After moving house, I feel naked and vulnerable all the time.
examples.traditional: 搬咗屋之後，我成日都冇安全感。
examples.jyutping: bun1 zo2 uk1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 mou5 on1 cyun4 gam2
